page.notes: Printed side marks in the left margin (small quotation-type glyphs, one beside most lines from "in uenenatum" down to "uel alius") are printed marks, not text, and are not transcribed as notes. The word "spe[?]ctemus" is doubtful: the scan shows "stemus" after a line break, and the first letters are unclear. "hysterice[?]" ends in a cedilla-like sign that is uncertain. "Huc" ends the last full line; "accedit" below it is a catchword. Long s is rendered as s throughout. Words broken at line ends with a printed hyphen are kept as "va-por", "arte-rias", "at-tigerit", "fun-ctiones", "coditio-ne", "fo-cus", "supe-riora", and "pro-pria". "possumus" is split across a line end without a visible hyphen and is written whole.
